The '''Average Service Availability Index (ASAI)'''<ref>{{cite web
 |url=http://www.ee.iastate.edu/~jdm/ee653/DistributionReliabilityPredictive.ppt 
 |title=Distribution System Reliability Evaluation 
 |first=Sree 
 |last=Yeddanapudi 
 |publisher=Iowa State University 
 |accessdate=18 June 2011 
 |url-status=dead 
 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20111226034249/http://www.ee.iastate.edu/~jdm/ee653/DistributionReliabilityPredictive.ppt 
 |archivedate=26 December 2011 
}}</ref><ref name="Pham2003">{{cite book|last=Pham|first=Hoang|title=Handbook of reliability engineering|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Xe6Z4wKQFMoC&pg=PA514|accessdate=21 July 2011|date=8 April 2003|publisher=Birkhäuser|isbn=978-1-85233-453-6|pages=514}}</ref> is a [[reliability index]] commonly used by [[electric power]] [[utilities]]. ASAI is calculated as

<math>\mbox{ASAI} = \frac{\sum{N_i} \times 8760 - \sum{U_i N_i}}{\sum{N_i} \times 8760}</math>

where <math>N_i</math> is the number of customers and <math>U_i</math> is the annual outage time (in hours) for location <math>i</math>. ASAI can be represented in relation to [[SAIDI]] (when the annual SAIDI is given in hours, 8760 is the number of hours in a year)

<math>\mbox{ASAI} = 1 - \frac{\mbox{SAIDI} }{8760}</math>
